regions.merged_text: Thank you for your kind favor of August 2. The world is full of misunderstanding, but often God uses its mistakes to correct us, to give us the right out- look on life and its eternal destiny. Yes, I shall join my poor prayers to yours so that God may give you the happiness of always conforming your will to His.
